sections.title: Rosette and flowers
sections.text: Puya alpestris is a Chilean bromeliad that forms a dense rosette of stiff, spiny leaves. The flowering plant reaches about 1.2–2.5 m. Its branched inflorescence bears metallic blue to blue-green flowers with orange pollen.

sections.title: Leaves and seeds
sections.text: A taxonomic revision records leaves up to about 98 cm long, with spines 2–8 mm long. Its capsule is about 1.5–2.2 cm long and contains winged seeds.

sections.title: Comparison
sections.text: Its blue-green flowers distinguish it from the yellow-flowered Puya chilensis.
